# Viking Takes Delivery of Newest River Ship in Europe


November 18, 2026 4:15 pm EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_f740799669936a542adda0b5cc8ad1ea/vikingcruises/news/2026-11-18_Viking_Takes_Delivery_of_Newest_River_Ship_in_254.pdf)


*The Viking Halogi Joins Award-Winning Fleet of Viking Longships*


LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Viking® ([www.viking.com](http://www.viking.com/) ) (NYSE: VIK) today announced it has taken delivery of the[Viking Halogi](https://www.vikingrivercruises.com/ships/longships/viking-halogi.html) , the company’s newest[Viking Longship](https://www.vikingrivercruises.com/ships/longships/index.html?adobe_mc=TS%3D1793930727%7CMCMID%3D50250465892538323764148743927764581429%7CMCORGID%3D8FC267C25245B36B0A490D4C%2540AdobeOrg&_gl=1*eoz6jj*_ga*OTIxMjY5OTczLjE3OTM5Mjg5MTQ.*_ga_24KNYDH1S6*czE3OTM5Mjg5MTMkbzEkZzEkdDE3OTM5MzA1ODgkajYwJGwwJGgw) ®. The 190-guest *Viking Halogi* joins ** Viking’s fleet of state-of-the-art sister ships and will sail the company’s popular itineraries on the Rhine River.


This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:[https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261118971335/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261118971335/en/)


Viking today announced it has taken delivery of the Viking Halogi, the company’s newest Viking Longship®. The 190-guest Viking Halogi joins Viking’s award-winning fleet of state-of-the-art sister ships and will sail the company’s popular itineraries on the Rhine River. Pictured here, a sister ship in the Viking Longship fleet on the Rhine River. For more information, visit www.viking.com.


“For nearly three decades, Viking has offered travelers a meaningful way to explore the history and culture of Europe through river travel,” said Leah Talactac, President and Chief Executive Officer of Viking. “We are pleased to welcome the *Viking Halogi* to our award-winning fleet and to offer even more curious travelers the opportunity to experience Europe in Viking comfort.”


**The *Viking Halogi***


Hosting 190 guests in 95 staterooms, the *Viking Halogi* features elegant Scandinavian design and the industry-leading innovations for which Viking is known, including the patented square bow that enables three full decks, the indoor/outdoor Aquavit Terrace and the proprietary asymmetric corridor layout that allows for true two-room suites. The *Viking Halogi* will sail popular itineraries, including[Rhine Getaway](https://www.vikingrivercruises.com/cruise-destinations/europe/rhine-getaway/2027-basel-amsterdam/index.html) and[Christmas on the Rhine](https://www.vikingrivercruises.com/cruise-destinations/europe/christmas-on-the-rhine/2027-amsterdam-basel/index.html) , as well as the new **[Oberammergau, Innsbruck & the Rhine](https://www.vikingrivercruises.com/cruise-destinations/europe/oberammergau-innsbruck-and-the-rhine/2030-amsterdam-munich/index.html) itinerary offered in 2030.


**Viking’s Growing Fleet**


Viking continues to execute its long-term growth plans, further strengthening the company’s position as a global leader in experiential travel. Based on Viking’s committed orderbook, the company expects to take delivery of 25 additional river ships by 2030, 11 additional ocean ships by 2032 and two additional expedition ships by 2031. With these orders, Viking will have 123 river ships in 2030 and 28 ocean and expedition ships in 2032.


**Media Assets**


For more information about Viking, or for images and b-roll, please contactvikingpr@edelman.com .


**About Viking** Viking (NYSE: VIK) is a global leader in experiential travel with a fleet of more than 100 ships, exploring 21 rivers, five oceans and all seven continents. Designed for curious travelers with interests in science, history, culture and cuisine, Executive Chairman Torstein Hagen often says Viking offers experiences For The Thinking Person™. Viking has more than 450 awards to its name, including being rated #1 for Rivers and #1 for Oceans six years in a row by *Condé Nast Traveler* in the 2026 Readers’ Choice Awards. Viking is also rated a “World’s Best” by *Travel + Leisure* —no other travel company has simultaneously received such honors by both publications. For additional information, contact Viking at 1-800-2-VIKING (1-800-284-5464) or visit[www.viking.com](http://www.viking.com/) .
